label: Turn-back 4.0 cm

profile.distinguishingDetail: The 4.0 cm turnback is a slightly wider version of the kissing/cocktail cuff, folding back a full four centimetres so that the reversed cuff band is visibly broader and more assertive on the wrist. The additional width makes the turned fabric more prominent in motion and allows more of the lining or facing fabric to show, which is a prized detail in bespoke work. This cuff width sits at the generous end of the turnback spectrum and is associated with a relaxed confidence, often favoured on sports jackets, odd coats, and evening wear where the sleeve end becomes a conscious focal point.
